senses.gloss:
Kautuka
name of C. by Rāmeśvara Śukla on Tarkasaṅgraha of Annam Bhaṭṭa. Baroda 11990 (ms. d. 1765 A. D.).

Kautukakathā
Jain. Chani 3163.

Kautukakalikākathā
Jain. Moodbidri II. 203b.

Kautukakrīḍā
Allahabad 178 (57).

Kautukacintāmaṇi
magic, med., toilet, aphrodisiac, arboriculture, kings' pastimes etc. described a. part of a larger work.
The identity of the following works is not known-
America 5322. B. III. 80. BISM. v.. 453/7. BORI. 1031 of 1884-87. Burnell 69b (5 mss. all inc.). Cuttack 33. IM. 5335 (inc.). Kavīndrācārya 2050. MT. 1040 (a. (inc.). Oudh IX. 26. R. A. Sastri II. p. 207. RASB. VIII. B. 6564. Rgb. 1031 (inc.). Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 7. TD. 11048-52. 17625, Trippūṇittura II. 127. Turuttikkāṭṭu Maṭham 6A.
--Svapnaśānti from. Bikaner 5365b.
A text of this name an. of similar contents compiled from several sources an. with Marathi transl., has been ptd., Poona, 1886.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 406. [Page105-a.

Kautukacintāmaṇi
or Garuḍamantraśāstra. Taylor II. 365 (inc.).
--described a. Śiva-Pārvatī-saṁvāda, forming part of Mahākalpa. TD. XX. Sup. no. 386.

Kautukacintāmaṇi
on similar subjects ascribed to Siddha Nāgārjuna. Filliozat I. 26 (Kautūhalacintāmaṇi from his Kakṣapuṭa). Kavīndrācārya 2054. MT. 2800. TCD. 1618B (Siddhanāgārjunakalpa). Trav. Uni. 10761. L. 22. C. 406B. 3503B (inc.). 11096A (inc.). Viśvabhāratī 2031 (28 Paṭalas).

Kautukacintāmaṇi
on similar subjects in 3 sections by King Pratāparudradeva, C. 1520 A. D.
Bd. 981. Bik. 1410. Bikaner 3965-67. 3968 (fr.). BORI. 1031 of 1884-87. 981 of 1887-91. IO. 2725. 2726 (K. nirūpaṇa or ºprayoga). K. 248. L. 3108. Mithilā. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 47.

Kautukacintāmaṇi
med. by Kadambeśvara. Mandlik p. 72, BK. 5 (d. 1718 A. D.).

Kautukacintāmaṇi
tantra. by Vallabhendra. Oppert I. 2594. 2809.

Kautukacintāmaṇi
jy. Viśvabhāratī 2264 (inc.). 1049.
--by Rāma, son of Gaṇeśa, grandson of Dhanvantari an. a resident of Cambay (Stambhatīrtha). Q. Śīghrabodha of Kāśīnātha an. Sajjanavallabhā (later than 1600 A. D.). BBRAS. 226. Bhau Dāji 6.
--by Sūrajī Gaṇaka. NP. V. 90.

Kautukacintāmaṇi
kāvya. by Jagannātha Paṇḍitarāja. CPB. 1093-1096. Oudh XV. 144. XXI. 178.

Kautukacintāmaṇi
a play (?). R. A. Sastri I. p. 110.

Kautukatantra
upatantra. Kavīndrācārya 1814. [Page105-b]

Kautukadeva
--Śṛṅgārakautūhala. kāmaśāstra. MT. 3357 (b).

Kautukanibandha
kāvya. PUL. II. p. 253.

Kautukaprakaraṇa
from Prastāvaratnākara. by Haridāsa, son of Puruṣottama. IM. 5352 (inc.).

Kautukabandha
dh. from Prayogaratna. Baroda 8823 (b).

Kautukabandhanaprayoga
śr. by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa. B. I. 220.

Kautukamañjarī
verses on love. L. 1127.

Kautukamañjarī
kāvya. by Bharata. SSPC. II. C. 8. 99.

Kautukamañjarīṭīkā
by Yādavasena. BISM. v.. 214/1 (1st khaṇḍa).

Kautukayoga
magic-med. etc. Śiva-Pārvatīsaṁvāda. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 20. MD. 7800 (inc.).

Kautukaratna
IM. 3925 (inc.). 5509 (inc.).
--ascribed to Śālivāhana. BORI. 1032 of 1884-87. Rgb. 1032.

Kautukaratnakośa
tantra. Mithilā.

Kautukaratnākara
prahasana. by Kavitārkika, son of Vāṇīnātha, written a. the instance of Lakṣmaṇa Māṇikya (end of 16th Cent. A. D.) of Bhuluyā (in Noakali).
Dacca 1821. Hpr. I. 84. IO. 4197.
For a. analysis of the play see C. Cappeller in Gurupūjākaumudī (Festschrift A. Weber), Leipzig, 1896, p.. 62-63; also S. K. D., Poona Ori. VII. p. 155.

Kautukaratnāvali
on jugglery etc. BORI. 723 of 1895-1902. CPB. 1097 (med.). C.. V. [Page106-a. 17 (inc.). (tantra). Jainagranthāvalī p. 361. Peters. IV. p. 42 (no. 1115). Extr. p. 64 (inc.). Trav. Uni. 9791 (inc.).

Kautukalakṣaṇa
śilpa. Oppert II. 3998.

Kautukalakṣaṇarathalakṣaṇa
from Vaikhānasāgama. Mysore I. p. 595.

Kautukalāvalī_(?)
IM. 3888. Perhaps K. līlāvatī below.

Kautukalīlāvatī
jy. Adyar II. p. 48b. AK. 852. America 5105. Bik. 670. BORI. 852 of 1891-95. Nasik IV. 21 (also called Jyotiṣasāroddhāra). NP. X. 48. Oudh VIII. 14.
--by Parama. B. IV. 120. Perhaps same a. the next.

Kautukalīlāvatī
jy. in 72 verses. by Rāma (candra) Bhaṭṭa, son of Vidyādhara; of Śrīmāli family (?).
BORI. 144 of Ā883-84. 803 of 1884-87. Lz. 986. Mithilā III. 34. Peters. II. p. 192 (no. 144). RASB. X. 6833. Rgb. 803. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1903, p. 30 (no. 1086 dupl.). Trav. Uni. 1689.

Kautukaśekhara
magic etc. Kavīndrācārya 2064.

Kautukasarvasva
allegorical prahasana. by Gopīnātha (Sarasvatī or Cakravartin). AS. p. 51. Dacca 332. C. 1580. D.(inc.). 608. C. 1089 (inc.). IO. 7399. Jones 414 (63). Rep. Hpr. 1901-6, p. 12. Vaṅgīya p. 210 (inc.).
For a. analysis of the play, see Wilson, Hindu Theatre II. p. 410 an. Cappeller, Gurupūjākaumudī, Leipzig, 1896, p.. 59-62; also S. K. D., Poona Ori. VII. p.. 154-55.
Pt.. Calcutta, 1828, with a Bengali version.

Kautukasāroddhāra
or rAjavinoda Tantric-med. in 15 chs. Compilation based on Nāgārjunasaṁhitā, Yogaratnāvalī, Kāmaratna [Page106-b] an. Kautukacintāmaṇi by Anūpasiṁha. Bikaner. (Not found in the Cat.).
See Adyar Library Bulletin XI. p.. 21-3.

Kautukasundarī
kāvya. Trav. Uni. 14321B (inc.).

Kautukāgama
a. Upāgama. Kavīndrācārya 1597.

Kautukāni(subhāṣitasaṅgraha)
kāvya. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 72 (no. 602).

Kautukārṇava
jy. Anūpakautukārṇava.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 216a.

Kautūhalacintāmaṇi
by Siddha Nāgārjuna; from his Kakṣapuṭa. Bik. 1277. Filliozat I. 26.
C.. Kautukacintāmaṇi above.

Kautūhalavidyā(indrajāla)
from Mantrasāra. by Pārvatīputra Nityanātha. L. 614.
C.. Upadeśa 13 of the edn. of Mantrakhaṇḍa of a., Rasagranthamālā 3, Gondal, 1926, p.. 87-98.

Kautūhalāryā(kṛṣṇāryā)
kāvya. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 83 (no. 301).

Kautsa
Q. in Āśvalāyana śr. sūtra I. 2, 5. VII. 1, 19; in Lāṭyāyanaśrautasūtra 10, 2, 9; in Āpast. dharma sūtra I. 19. 4; 28. 1; in Hemādri's Pariśeṣakhaṇḍa 2, 251; in Nīlāmbarācārya's Kālakaumudī (See p. 84, J. of G. Jhā Res. Inst. XIV. i-iv. 1956-57); in Jīmūtavāhana's Kālaviveka (See Kane, HDS. I. p. 689b).

Kautsa
grammarian. Q. by Yāska in Nirukta I. 15.
For a discussion on his real position here, see ABORI. XII. 1930-31, p.. 40-9.

Kautsa
grammarian. a pupil of Pāṇini (?) ref. to in Mahābhāṣya III. 2. 108 (upasedivAn kautsaH pANinim). [Page107-a.

Kautsa
--Kautsavyākaraṇa.
See below.

Kautsa
one of the sons of Bharata, mentioned in Nāṭya Śāstra, I. 29. GOS. edn.

Kautsavyaniruktanighaṇṭu
48th Av. pariśiṣṭa. Mu7nchen 183 (52). Tb. 214.
See edn. Leipzig, 1910.
Pt.. Ārṣa Granthāvalī Vol. XVII. no. 3. 4. 5. Lahore, 1921. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p.. 1306. 1764.

Kautsavyākaraṇa
Av. in 4 chs. by Kautsa. Ujjain II. p. 37 (inc.).
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 109a.
